enchantments.tooltip: Upgradeable - Tier 1: This item is a Tier 1 upgradable item.

children.tooltip: +2 Enhancement Bonus: +2 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.
Righteous: This weapon is imbued with holy power, giving it an additional +2 to attack bonus and damage against any evil creature. This power makes the weapon good-aligned.
Undead Bane 2: Those that have died must return, and this weapon is attuned specifically to lay them to rest. This weapon deals an additional 2d10 bane damage vs. Undead.
Incandescence: This weapon glows with the light of Irian. This weapon deals an extra 1 to 6 points of light damage on a successful hit.
